sentence: O cielo no ye claro hue.
ipa: o ˈθjelo ˈno ˈʝe ˈklaɾo ˈwe
gloss_en: The sky is not clear today.
notes: Distinción ⟨c⟩ [θ] 'cielo' and Ĕ>ie diphthong [ˈθjelo] per nagore_lain2001; Aragonese copula 'ye' and article 'o' per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: Estos zapatos cuestan cuaranta euros.
ipa: ˈestos θaˈpatos kwesˈtan kwaˈɾanta ˈewɾos
gloss_en: These shoes cost forty euros.
notes: ⟨z⟩ [θ] distinción and Ŏ>ue 'cuestan' [kweˈstan] per nagore_lain2001; ⟨s⟩+voiced onset sandhi 'estos zapatos' per hualde2005.

sentence: A reunión ye maitín a las tres.
ipa: a rewˈnion ˈʝe majˈtin a las ˈtɾes
gloss_en: The meeting is tomorrow morning at three.
notes: Aragonese 'maitín' (morning) and copula 'ye' per nagore_lain2001; word-initial trill [r] 'reunión' per hualde2005.

sentence: Mi chirmán bibe en a bila.
ipa: ˈmi tʃiɾˈman ˈbiβe en a ˈbila
gloss_en: My brother lives in the town.
notes: Aragonese 'chirmán' (brother) with initial ⟨ch⟩ [tʃ] and intervocalic ⟨b⟩ approximant [β] 'bibe' per nagore_lain2001; 'bila' per penny2002.

sentence: Ves de frente y tuerce en a primera carrera.
ipa: ˈbes de ˈfɾente ʝ ˈtweɾθe en a pɾiˈmeɾa kaˈreɾa
gloss_en: Go straight ahead and turn at the first street.
notes: F- retained 'frente' [f] and Ŏ>ue with distinción 'tuerce' [ˈtweɾθe] per nagore_lain2001; Aragonese 'carrera' (street) per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: A carne d'aquel puesto yera buena.
ipa: a ˈkaɾne ð aˈkel ˈpwesto ˈʝeɾa ˈbwena
gloss_en: The meat from that place was good.
notes: Ŏ>ue 'puesto','buena' per nagore_lain2001; imperfect 'yera' (was) per nagore_lain2001; clitic elision ⟨d'⟩ before vowel per hualde2005.

sentence: Án ye a clau?
ipa: ˈan ˈʝe a ˈklaw
gloss_en: Where is the key?
notes: Aragonese interrogative 'án' (where) and 'clau' (key, F->none, -AV- diphthong [aw]) per nagore_lain2001; copula 'ye' per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: Cuántas presonas bienen a cenar?
ipa: ˈkuantas pɾeˈsonas bjeˈnen a θeˈnaɾ
gloss_en: How many people are coming to dinner?
notes: Ĕ>ie 'bienen' [bjeˈnen] and distinción ⟨ce⟩ [θ] 'cenar' per nagore_lain2001; metathesis 'presonas' per penny2002.

sentence: Si yo podese, mercarba aquella casa.
ipa: si ˈʝo poˈðese meɾˈkaɾba aˈkeʎa ˈkasa
gloss_en: If I could, I would buy that house.
notes: Genuinely Aragonese conditional in -arba 'mercarba' and verb 'mercar' (to buy) per nagore_lain2001; imperfect subjunctive 'podese' per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: Ahiere merqué cinco quilos de cereixas.
ipa: aˈjeɾe meɾˈke ˈθinko ˈkilos de θeˈɾejʃas
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought five kilos of cherries.
notes: Distinción ⟨c⟩ [θ] 'cinco','cereixas' and ⟨ix⟩ [ʃ] 'cereixas' [θeˈɾejʃas] per nagore_lain2001; preterite 'merqué' per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: L'añada que bien iré ta Uesca.
ipa: ˈl aˈɲaða ke ˈbjen iˈɾe ta ˈweska
gloss_en: Next year I will travel to Huesca.
notes: Palatal nasal ⟨ñ⟩ [ɲ] 'añada' (year) and directional 'ta' (towards) per nagore_lain2001; F->none place-name 'Uesca' (Huesca) per penny2002.

sentence: Truca-me cuando plegues ta casa.
ipa: ˈtɾuka me ˈkwando ˈpleɡes ta ˈkasa
gloss_en: Call me when you get home.
notes: Aragonese 'trucar' (to call) and 'plegar' (to arrive) [ˈpleɡes] per nagore_lain2001; Ŏ>ue absent here, ⟨gu⟩ [ɡ] before front vowel per hualde2005.

sentence: Buenos diyas, cómo te ba?
ipa: ˈbwenos diˈʝas ˈkomo te ˈba
gloss_en: Good morning, how are you?
notes: Ŏ>ue 'buenos' [ˈbwenos] and Aragonese 'diya' (day, intervocalic -j-) per nagore_lain2001; greeting register per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: Más bale paxaro en man que ciento bolando.
ipa: ˈmas ˈbale paˈʃaɾo en ˈman ke ˈθjento boˈlando
gloss_en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
notes: ⟨x⟩ [ʃ] 'paxaro' (bird) and distinción ⟨ci⟩ [θ] with Ĕ>ie 'ciento' [ˈθjento] per nagore_lain2001; proverbial register per penny2002.

sentence: A muller biella pilla l'agulla amariella.
ipa: a muˈʎeɾ ˈbjeʎa ˈpiʎa ˈl aˈɣuʎa amaˈɾjeʎa
gloss_en: The old woman picks up the yellow needle.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'muller','biella','pilla','agulla','amariella' (Aragonese keeps /ʎ/, no yeísmo) and Ĕ>ie 'biella','amariella' per nagore_lain2001; clitic ⟨l'⟩ per hualde2005.

sentence: O can corre por a ribera d'o río.
ipa: o ˈkan ˈkore poɾ a riˈβeɾa ð o ˈrio
gloss_en: The dog runs along the riverbank.
notes: Trill/tap contrast ⟨rr⟩ [r] 'corre', word-initial [r] 'río' vs tap [ɾ] 'ribera' per hualde2005; Aragonese 'can' (dog) per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: Feito y güeit fan una ueitena.
ipa: ˈfejto ʝ ˈɡweit ˈfan una weiˈtena
gloss_en: Done, and eight make a set of eight.
notes: F- retained 'feito' [f] (< FACTU) and -CT- > -it- 'feito','güeit' [ˈɡweit] — the Aragonese kernel reflex per nagore_lain2001; numeral 'güeit' (eight) per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: A finestra d'a montaña ye ubierta.
ipa: a fiˈnestɾa ð a monˈtaɲa ˈʝe uˈβjeɾta
gloss_en: The mountain window is open.
notes: Palatal nasal ⟨ñ⟩ [ɲ] 'montaña' and Ŏ>ie 'ubierta' [uˈβjeɾta] per nagore_lain2001; Aragonese 'finestra' (window) per nagore_lain2001; clitic ⟨d'⟩ per hualde2005.

sentence: Plebe muito sobre os campos berdes.
ipa: ˈpleβe ˈmwito sobɾe os ˈkampos ˈbeɾdes
gloss_en: It rains a lot over the green fields.
notes: Aragonese 'plebe' (it rains) and 'muito' (much, < MULTU, -LT- kept) per nagore_lain2001; plural article 'os' per nagore_lain2001.

sentence: No creigo que nieve sobre aquel tozal.
ipa: ˈno ˈkɾejɣo ke ˈnjeβe sobɾe aˈkel toˈθal
gloss_en: I do not think it will snow over that hill.
notes: Ĕ>ie 'nieve' [ˈnjeβe] and Aragonese 'creigo' (I believe), 'tozal' (hill) per nagore_lain2001; negation frame per penny2002.
